$comment: Bounded work packets for the mobile/continuity/notification productization program. C0-C4 landed via #500/#503. C5-C9 are the completion-program packets (driven by plan M2-M8; M-numbers noted per objective). Each packet lists objective, reuse targets, allowed paths, contracts/invariants, acceptance, and required tests. Specialists work from these + context-index.json without rescanning the repo.

packets.objective: Reconciliation + orchestration control plane; no runtime behavior change.
invariants: credential registry references, not duplicates, the credential platform

packets.objective: Continuation plane + client-sync feed + contract twins (continuation, sync-event, deep-link).
existing_systems_to_reuse: repositories/repos.py (as a NON-fit — use direct SQL)
invariants: direct-SQL CAS via state_revision (409 on stale)
idempotent create ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
t:/o: scope isolation, 404 not 403 on cross-scope

packets.objective: Notification control-plane branding + TS twins + coverage registry + collision fix.
invariants: delivery Enum parity via {e.value for e in Enum}

packets.objective: Push/email provider adapters + local fakes + installation/push model + deep-link resolve.
Shared mobile platform + native security + compiling app shells + workspace/CI wiring.
invariants: no Kyber code in Aether binary
compiling shells only — full screens are C5-C6
acceptance_criteria: both apps compile for iOS-sim + Android-emulator

packets.objective: Feature screens + projections + mobile platform foundations + desktop notification center. (Plan M2 + M3 + M4: M2 = mobile config route + distribution profiles + app-version registration + packages/mobile-ui + read-only offline cache + mobile-compliance-check umbrella; M3 = bounded redacted gateway projections + Aether Mobile screens + Aether desktop notification center + preferences persistence; M4 = Kyber Mobile operator screens + Kyber desktop polish.)
existing_systems_to_reuse: services/profile/* Profile360 truth (projections read, never re-calculate)
shared_paths_requiring_orchestrator: Backend Architecture/aether-backend/main.py (mount mobile config + projection routes)
config/settings.py (flags: mobile.enabled gates; new feature flags default OFF)
contracts: MobileConfigResponse (snake_case: min_version, latest_version, upgrade_policy, distribution_profile, feature_flags, service_capabilities, externally_blocked_providers)
ProjectionResponse shapes (today_digest, profile_summary, campaign_summary, alerts_inbox, explore_briefing)
invariants: projections REUSE owning services, never re-calculate Profile360/Campaign360/graph truth
offline cache is read-only (no offline mutation)
no second inbox / no second saved-view store
acceptance_criteria: GET /v1/mobile/config returns typed config with distribution + feature flags + externally-blocked providers
apps added to npm workspaces with typecheck+test gates green
projection endpoints return bounded redacted summaries with provenance
Aether Mobile Today/Copilot/Explore/Alerts/Account screens typecheck + consume SDK
Aether desktop notification center (inbox UI + badge + filters + read/ack) + preferences persistence route

packets.objective: Continue-on-phone + sync completion + operator continuation router. (Plan M5: wire the remaining 9 sync producers via enqueue_sync_change at owning mutation sites; operator (Kyber) continuation router in services/continuation/; desktop continue-on-phone / recent-activity / resume surfaces in both frontends; mobile continue-on-desktop / resume / send-to-desktop; client-sync consumption UI; cross-device read/ack propagation verified.)
contracts: SyncEvent change types all wired (notification/saved_view/conversation/watchlist/incident/command_receipt/preference_changed/session/installation_revoked + continuation_changed)
OperatorContinuationRouter shape (o: scope, tenant-side continuation lifecycle)
invariants: every producer wired at its OWNING mutation site (no central aggregator)
read/ack state propagates across devices (notification opened on mobile shows read on desktop)
operator router never crosses tenant/operator boundary
acceptance_criteria: operator continuation create/resume routes work (o: scope)

packets.objective: Governed mobile actions + mobile action adapter + Tier 0-3 UI. (Plan M6: gateway adapter exposing action availability + adapting mobile step-up challenges to the EXISTING services/kyber/ops command plane — no generic mutation channel, no second command plane; Kyber Mobile Tier 0/1/2/3 UI + step-up via existing StepUpService/device_proof; durable command-receipt visibility in Kyber Mobile + desktop; mobile-bound device signature/attestation where feasible; no offline mutation; no endpoint naming arbitrary actions.)
existing_systems_to_reuse: services/kyber/devices/device_proof.py (extend for mobile-bound signature where feasible)
invariants: adapter REUSES services/kyber/ops (no second command plane)
acceptance_criteria: adapter exposes availability + step-up adaptation on gateway
Tier 0/1/2/3 UI in Kyber Mobile typechecks + consumes adapter
command receipts durable + visible in Kyber Mobile + desktop
mobile-bound device signature where feasible (fails open only outside production)
required_tests: adapter -> ops integration tests (dry-run -> approve -> execute -> verify)

packets.objective: Adversarial review + remediation + final gate. (Plan M8: six independent review lenses in parallel — architecture/duplication, tenant-operator security, data truth/evidence, concurrency/delivery/reliability, mobile privacy/store compliance, operational/release honesty — each verifying (not self-certifying); adversarial refute pass; remediation commits; final make ci-check + release-gate decision.)
allowed_paths: ** (review reads everything; remediation restricted to discovered defects)
shared_paths_requiring_orchestrator: any remediation touch of main.py / settings / specs / shared index / Makefile / alembic / generated docs
invariants: reviewers never certify their own implementation
every claim traced to evidence (test name / gate output)
no fabricated evidence; externally_blocked stays honest
acceptance_criteria: confirmed findings remediated (or explicitly accepted with evidence)
make docs-fix + make ci-check green at final tip
make release-gate assessed (release readiness is an owner decision)
PR body lists every milestone with evidence + external blockers
required_tests: targeted re-runs of suites touched by remediation
